title: Choose the visual world for Roosters
question: The roll assigned The Blueprint/Schematic. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Blueprint / Schematic
options.thesis: A crisp, technical dashboard that treats cron jobs as structured engineering elements.
options.viewport: A dense but organized grid showing active jobs, latest pings, and alert status, with drafting lines separating regions.
options.risk: Can look overly complicated or cluttered if spacing is not strictly maintained.

raised.raise: High-contrast status colour coding (bold red for failure, vibrant green for success).
Unified SVG-style border scaling for a crisp, app-like feel.

options.label: The Server Rack
options.thesis: A tactile, hardware-inspired dashboard where jobs are rack-mounted units.
options.viewport: Rows of 'hardware units' representing cron jobs, with glowing status lights.
options.risk: Also the direction most runs in this category land on. Can feel heavy.

options.label: Braun RT 20
options.thesis: A deeply tactile, minimalist console prioritizing physical affordances.
options.viewport: A starkly clean dashboard with mechanical-feeling toggles and an orange alert accent.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: brings absolute clarity to task monitoring without the typical dark-mode tropes.
options.risk: Can feel disconnected from software expectations if controls are too literal.

options.label: Chicago Transit Map
options.case: Fuses poorly: transit implies complex geographic routing, which overcomplicates simple cron monitoring.
options.kept: High-contrast status colour coding (bold red for failure, vibrant green for success).

options.label: Field Guide Map
options.case: Fuses poorly: organic illustrations contradict the precise, technical nature of cron scheduling.
options.kept: Unified SVG-style border scaling for a crisp, app-like feel.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What this category ships, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: A standard sidebar navigation with white data cards on a light grey background.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
